title: Harden local deploy health check
description: Harden the local deploy pipeline: serialize rapid pushes and prove rollback works. ## Incident Summary Two rapid pushes raced and left staging half-deployed for **58 minutes**. ## Runbook Draft ~~~bash deploy queue status deploy rollback --env staging --to previous deploy verify --gate healthcheck ~~~ ## Done When - [x] Per-branch deploy lock exists locally - [ ] Health-check gate blocks bad releases - [ ] Rollback finishes in under 3 minutes - [ ] Five pushes in 60 seconds do not race ## Escalation If the gate fails twice, page the merger and post the failed release id in #deploys.
